nvitk.pipes.bbtpy.util.eicab_masks¶

Resolve eICAB Circle-of-Willis (CW) or whole-brain (WB) multilabel masks (local copy; no qvtpy import).

nvitk.pipes.bbtpy.util.eicab_masks.resolve_eicab_mask(eicab_dir: pathlib.Path, preference: EicabMaskKind = 'cw') → EicabMaskResolution¶

Return the eICAB label NIfTI path for preference, with warn-and-fallback.

If the requested mask is missing but the alternate exists, logs a warning and uses the alternate. Raises FileNotFoundError if neither exists.
